evals.prompt: Make a reusable GLTF car paint surface more metallic, add a per-selected-car highlight, and avoid changing every car that shares the base material.
evals.expected_output: A PBR/material-ownership solution that distinguishes shared material state from a deliberate clone or non-duplicating highlight mechanism.
assertions: Uses MeshStandardMaterial or MeshPhysicalMaterial only as justified by the visual need
Explains that shared material mutation affects every consumer
Includes a disposal path for any unique clone

evals.prompt: Our albedo map is too dark and the normal map has the wrong color-space treatment.
evals.expected_output: Routes image-map configuration to threejs-textures while retaining material semantic context.
assertions: Names threejs-textures as the primary map/color-space owner
Does not prescribe roughness changes as a substitute for color/data handling
